blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The idea is good, but the execution is awful.
exercises.ru: Идея-то хороша, ___ вот исполнение никудышное.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is a warlock and Mary is a witch.
exercises.ru: Том колдун, ___ Мэри ведьма.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not German, but Austrian.
exercises.ru: Он не немец, ___ австриец.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is addicted to Coke, but he doesn't like Pepsi.
exercises.ru: Том пристрастился к кока-коле, ___ он не любит пепси.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My name's not Anna, it's Carmen.
exercises.ru: Меня зовут не Анна, ___ Кармен.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Samuel doesn't have three brothers, he only has two.
exercises.ru: У Самуила не три брата, ___ только два.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Seals are clumsy and ponderous on land, but very graceful in the water.
exercises.ru: Тюлени неуклюжи и неповоротливы на земле, ___ очень грациозны в воде.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But here is the long-awaited highway.
exercises.ru: ___ вот и долгожданное шоссе.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My name is Edward, but everyone calls me Ned.
exercises.ru: Меня зовут Эдвард, ___ все зовут меня Недом.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Misato tried to be calm, but finally she lost her temper.
exercises.ru: Мисато пыталась быть спокойной, ___ в конце концов вышла из себя.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Martino went all around the basement slowly, but didn't see anything strange at all.
exercises.ru: Мартино медленно обошёл весь подвал, ___ ничего странного не увидел.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
exercises.ru: Не материальные, ___ духовные вещи определяют нашу жизнь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom played spoons and Mary played kazoo.
exercises.ru: Том играл на ложках, ___ Мэри — на казу.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The corpus is not structured as a table but as a graph.
exercises.ru: Этот корпус структурирован не как таблица, ___ как граф.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Michale smiled, wanted to say something, but didn't dare.
exercises.ru: Микале улыбнулся, что-то хотел сказать, ___ не посмел.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm not slow to forgive, but I remember everything.
exercises.ru: Я не злопамятен, ___ всё помню.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I can tolerate cold weather but not hot weather.
exercises.ru: Я могу стерпеть холодную погоду, ___ не жаркую.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: "Michael" is a man's name, but "Michelle" is a woman's name.
exercises.ru: «Михаил» — это мужское имя, ___ «Мишель» — это женское имя.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That's cute and all, but it isn't feasible.
exercises.ru: Всё это, конечно, прекрасно, ___ нереализуемо.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He gives with one hand and takes away with the other.
exercises.ru: Он одной рукой даёт, ___ другой отбирает.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
